BiblicalUsage: tsippûwy is the word the Bible uses when it means an overlay, a plating of metal. In Exodus 38:17, the overlaying of their chapiters of silver, and it appears again in Numbers 16:38.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsippûwy still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
